tool.name: ParaFEM BC Schedule Generator
tool.description: Generate a time-varying boundary condition schedule (.bcs)

param.name: mesh_d
param.label: Mesh geometry (.d)
param.help: ParaFEM .d file from mesh generator or mesh import tool

param.name: schedule_config
param.label: BC Schedule Configuration (JSON)
param.help: JSON array of schedule entries. Each entry has 'step' and 'zones'.

param.name: nset_file
param.label: Node sets (.nset)
param.help: Input .nset file from ParaFEM Mesh Import tool

tool.help:
Generates a ParaFEM time-varying boundary condition schedule (.bcs) file.
This tool reads a mesh `.d` file and a JSON configuration defining temperature changes at specific time steps. The output `.bcs` file can be used by solvers that support BC scheduling, like the GDPS Transient Thermal Solver.
Schedule Configuration is a JSON array where each entry contains: - step: The time step index at which the BCs should be updated. - zones: An array of zone definitions, identical to the format used by the static BC generator tools (either axis-based or NSET-based).
The tool re-calculates the full set of fixed nodes for each time step in the schedule to ensure the node ordering in the `.bcs` file is consistent with the static `.fix` file required by the solver.
